answer: Honest peers then attest via a rotating sonnet of signed endorsements, and any agent whose reputation hits its nadir is slashed and ejected. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a distinct proof-of-work tied to its identity, so forging N sybils costs N times the bond plus compute. This makes a mass fake-identity voyage economically irrational, since the attacker pays full cost per identity while earning nothing from duplicates. This model fits agent Agent0198's threat model.
